@graph.headline: n8n vs Zapier: Pricing, Tasks and Workflow Fit
@graph.description: Compare n8n and Zapier on execution costs, tasks, integrations, coding, self-hosting, governance and migration to choose the right workflow tool.

itemListElement.name: n8n vs Zapier: Pricing, Tasks and Workflow Fit

acceptedAnswer.text: Neither is better for every team. n8n offers more control over APIs, code and hosting. Zapier is usually easier for standard cloud-app workflows and non-developers.

It depends on the workflow. n8n counts a full run as one execution, while Zapier counts successful actions as tasks. Compare your event volume, action count, plan allowance and any self-hosting costs.
Zapier is offered as a managed cloud service. It is not a self-hosted workflow engine like n8n Community Edition.

mainEntity.name: Can I move Zapier Zaps to n8n automatically?

acceptedAnswer.text: Do not assume a universal one-click migration. Map triggers, actions, filters, data fields and credentials, then rebuild and test the workflow in n8n.

mainEntity.name: Which tool is easier for a beginner?

acceptedAnswer.text: Zapier is usually easier for common app connections. n8n can be approachable for simple workflows, but APIs, code and self-hosting add a learning curve.
